npc.example_merchant.greeting: Salut %s! Bine ai venit în magazinul meu. Spune {trade} pentru a vedea ofertele mele.

npc.example_merchant.low_level: [EN] Sorry, but you are too inexperienced. Come back when you reach level 8.
npc.example_merchant.name: Numele meu este Marcus. Conduc acest magazin.
npc.example_merchant.news_1: [EN] Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
npc.example_merchant.news_2: [EN] The king is looking for brave adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.trade: [EN] Of course! Here are my offers.
nv.example_merchant.1: Cele mai bune poțiuni din oraș!
